response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep experience in developer tooling, testing frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure, but his resume shows no evidence of people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or organizational leadership—core requirements for this manager-level role. His trajectory is Staff/Senior Engineer, not a management track, making him a poor fit despite relevant domain expertise.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools, test runners (Trial), and testing libraries (Fluent-Asserts)
Strong track record of technical leadership, CI/CD setup, and cross-language systems (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript)
Active knowledge-sharing history via workshops, talks, and mentoring-style courses (Selenium, Web Internals)
concerns: No evidence of formal people management, direct reports, or performance/career development responsibilities
Career progression is consistently IC-focused (Senior/Staff Engineer) with no manager or team-lead titles
No mobile-platform ecosystem experience aside from brief iOS/Apple TV work in 2015-2016

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
